technique_name: Describe three different approaches to estimating the effectiveness of an organization's training program.
description: Three different approaches to estimating the effectiveness of an organization's training program include pre- and post-training surveys, observation of employees’ work performance, and comparison of actual performance with training goals. Pre- and post-surveys can be used to compare the knowledge and attitudes of employees before and after the training program, and can provide insights into not just the training program but potentially other aspects of the organization as well.
